1> -- UNHANDLED EFFECT ------------------------------------- <repl>

This performs `Http`, and nothing at the prompt handles it. Run it inside
a handler, or install one for the inputs that follow with `with`.

1| Client.getText "http://example.com/"
   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
1> <value : StateResult Int ()> : StateResult Int ()
> answer : a -> Result b Bytes
> 1> 2> "ok" : String
2> Unhandled Error: InvalidUrl "relative" : Error
2> 1  with Client.stub answer
   provides {Http}
2  with Client.configure { c -> { c | userAgent = "levels" } }
   provides {Http}
2> 1> > r : Reader {local scope}
